note_tweet.text:
I have avoided commenting on most of Candace Owens's claims the past few months. However, her latest episode contains such a blatant untruth about Charlie's daily life that I feel compelled to correct it. 

In this episode, Candace Owens aggressively ridicules Erika for using the phrase "Shabbot shalom," and suggests that Charlie's last book, "Stop in the Name of God," about the value of observing the Sabbath, is a fabrication to make Charlie appear more pro-Jewish and pro-Israel than he really was.

It's very revealing that Candace would fixate on this, as it immediately reveals unfamiliarity with Charlie's behavior for the entire period that I knew him. Charlie was observing his evangelical Christian version of "shabbat" for the entire time I worked under him. As a Catholic who sees Sunday as the Christian sabbath, I would tease Charlie about this! Even in early 2023, shortly after I joined the show, he was signing off his Friday shows with "Shabbat shalom." (see 2:58:45 here for one example: https://t.co/xI7liPE9vT). 

In fact, every week on Friday, around 9-10 pm, our last message from Charlie before he went dark for 24-36 hours was a "shabbot shalom" in one of our Telegram chats -- see below for the proof.

Charlie's love of Shabbat was completely genuine. To claim otherwise is a lie.
